question.text: Let <math><msqrt><mi>a</mi></msqrt><mo>+</mo><msqrt><mi>d</mi></msqrt><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mi>c</mi></msqrt><mo>+</mo><msqrt><mi>b</mi></msqrt></math> and <math><mi>a</mi><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>c</mi></math>, where <math><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi>b</mi><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi>c</mi><mo>∈</mo><msup><mrow><mi>R</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math>. If the family of lines <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>d</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> passes through a fixed point <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><msub><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></math>, then the value of <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub><mo>+</mo><msub><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> is

solution.text:
We have, a+d+2ad=c+b+2bc
⇒a+d=c+b (As, ad=bc )
∴a2+d2+2ad=c2+b2+2bc⇒a2+d2=c2+b2
Now, a2+d2x+b2y+c2=0
⇒b2+c2x+b2y+c2=0
⇒b2y+x+c2x+1=0
⇒y+x+c2b2x+1=0
which is of the form L1+λL2=0
So, the fixed point is -1,1=x0,y0 (Given).
Hence, x0+y0=-1+1=0.
